summary: APM feed s068_single is overloaded: 25.49 Gbps microburst exceeds 10 Gbps tool port (255% capacity). All other checks (duplicates, encryption, VLANs, one-way, drops) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker forwards full aggregate traffic to a single 10 Gbps APM port without load-balancing, filtering or slicing. A 1 ms burst peaked at 25.49 Gbps (2.55x port capacity, threshold 0.8), so egress queues overrun and the tool port is oversubscribed.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will randomly drop packets during bursts, causing missed transactions, inaccurate latency/Apdex, incomplete distributed traces and gaps in detection coverage despite needing both directions.

params.alternative: filter or slice headers as APM needs_full_payload=false

recommended_fix.why: Distribute 25+ Gbps aggregate across 3x10G APM ports (or 2x10G with filtering/slicing) to keep per-port utilization below 80% threshold and prevent burst drops while preserving flow symmetry for APM.
